name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: June Week 4 - Safe Debugging
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: Electricity used to run a circuit.
words.example: The power wire supplied electricity to the breadboard.

words.definition: The return path for electricity in a circuit.
words.example: Ground completed the circuit path back to the Arduino.

words.definition: A part that limits electric current.
words.example: The resistor protected the LED from too much current.

words.definition: The way something faces or moves.
words.example: The LED direction mattered because the longer leg went to power.

words.definition: A list used to make sure steps are done.
words.example: The checklist helped the group verify each wire.

words.definition: The person who builds the physical parts.
words.example: The builder placed the components on the breadboard.

words.definition: The person who works on the code.
words.example: The coder updated the Arduino sketch after each test.

words.definition: The person who writes notes or evidence.
words.example: The recorder wrote the problem and fix in the log.
